text:
Electricity is passed through molten sodium chloride using inert electrodes.
What is observed at the electrodes?
A
A colourless gas is produced at the negative electrode.
B
A pale yellow-green gas is produced at the positive electrode.
C
A silver-coloured metal is produced at the positive electrode.
D
No change is observed because the electrodes are inert.

options.label: A
options.text: A colourless gas is produced at the negative electrode.
